page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.large is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory is provisioned at 4.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. It features a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no integrated local storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

With a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance emphasizes deterministic compute processing over high-capacity memory retention. Because local storage is absent, persistent storage requires external cloud block storage attachments. The configuration presents a low resource footprint, offering cost efficiency for light compute tasks that require dedicated CPU execution without paying overhead for extra system memory or local NVMe drives.

The entry-level configuration of ecs.c8ine.large makes it suitable for light web servers, lightweight microservices, build nodes in continuous integration pipelines, small backend API endpoints, and low-concurrency batch processing tasks. It is designed for workloads that demand steady single-core or dual-core execution performance.
